Maas Midnight Release","colour":"#eb2fc5"},"image_url":"https://cdn1.bookmanager.com/i/1562584/CORRECT_ACOTAR.png?cb=1788872648"},{"id":6247420261028,"title":"Author Talk: Christina Tudor","description":"

Christina Tudor, debut author of the collection Call My Body a Cautionary Tale, will be in conversation with Hannah Grieco and Kristen Zory King, exploring girlhood, womanhood, agency, and belonging in a world where bodily autonomy is up for debate. Join us for readings, community, and Halloween candy.

Part magic, part real life, these stories feature unruly characters and the bodies they live in. Girls have third legs, a grieving couple gets a mail order ghost to haunt their house, a woman participates in a self-defense simulation, and more. CALL MY BODY A CAUTIONARY TALE weaves together eighteen urgent, darkly humorous stories in which characters attempt to have agency over their bodies, choices, and futures in an uncertain, often unsafe world. Stories in this book have been nominated for the Pushcart Prize and featured in Best Small Fictions, and according to Kathy Fish (Wild Life: Collective Works), “while reminiscent of the work of Carmen Maria Machado, this collection comes to us from a writer of inimitable voice and vision.”

Christina Tudor is a writer living in Washington, D.C. Her fiction has been featured in CRAFT, SmokeLong Quarterly, matchbook, The Citron Review, Best Small Fictions 2024, and more. She has received nominations for the Pushcart Prize and the Robert J. Dau Short Story Prize for Emerging Writers, and was a 2022 PEN America Emerging Voices Fellow in fiction. CALL MY BODY A CAUTIONARY TALE is her debut collection of flash fiction. Connect with her on Instagram @christinaltudor or at www.christinatudor.com
